An '''electromagnet''' was a type of [[Magnet/Legends|magnet]] in which the magnetic field was produced by the flow of electric current. A [[magclamp]] utilized electromagnetic power to pull itself closed, and a [[Maghook]] was composed of a cylindrical electromagnet.
